sections.content: How many people are "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale"?

145,930 people

were counted on the census as "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Sales supervisors oversee the activities of sales and related workers in retail and wholesale establishments.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 25 to 29 years. Of the whole working population 11.1% were aged 25 to 29 years. For people working as "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale", 18.3% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" was 65 years or older.

Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" included:

  • nannies and au pairs
  • communication operators
  • pensions and insurance clerks and assistants

More women than men had this job

Among people working as "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" there were more women than men (55.2% compared with 44.8%).

This means "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "sales occupations".

Men made up 44.8% and women made up 55.2% of "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women. This occupation was one of the jobs for which the proportion of men and women was closest to this overall picture.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" included:

  • solicitors and lawyers
  • fitness and wellbeing instructors
  • elementary sales occupations (other)

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Men and women with this occupation had a similar age profile, as shown in the chart below.

The percentage of men and women who are "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "sales supervisors - retail and wholesale", 9.8% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (71.7% compared with 28.3%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (98.7%) than self-employed (1.3%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Birmingham, this is in the region of the West Midlands.
